'''Getzo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as a spice dealer during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He claimed to have invented [[Glitterstim/Legends|Glitterstim]], [[Novajack]] and the [[Corellian Sunburst]] spices.<ref name="TOR" />
